changes:
Support OWE on FullMAC devices that offload it (NL80211_EXT_FEATURE_OWE_OFFLOAD), for the MacBook Neo's MediaTek MT7932.
Fix the four parser and buffer bugs from oss-security 2026/08/02 (rrm beacon report overflow, HE capabilities width set, mde_equal, FTE sub-element underflow), as alarm-aurora does.
notes: alarm-aurora's 0001-use-network-group-for-unprivileged-access.diff is Arch's group convention; Debian keeps upstream's netdev group, so it is not carried.
